title: Fix new nemo_rl API bugs and test on Slurm cluster
description:
## Objective
Fix refactored nemo_rl code from docs/architecture/ and docs/api/ and test on Slurm cluster with Deepseek distilled QWen 1.5B model.

## Requirements
1. Fix import and initialization bugs in new API
2. Test nemo_rl.train() function
3. Test GRPOTrainer.from_pretrained() 
4. Test SFTTrainer and DPOTrainer
5. Test single-node training
6. Test multi-node (2 nodes) training
7. Convert data/deepscaler/train.parquet format

## Success Criteria
- All new APIs work correctly
- Single-node training converges
- 2-node training works
- Create ./job_is_done file when complete
notes:
API changes completed and validated:
1. GRPOTrainer.fit() now returns TrainingResult (not Dict)
2. train.py handles GRPO-specific fit() signature
3. All imports work correctly (validated on cluster)

BLOCKED: Full training test requires Ray cluster setup. Current container lacks /opt/nemo_rl_venv. When using 'uv run', Ray workers fail to find ray module. Need: container with pre-built venv OR use ray.sub for cluster setup.
